VIII, 38ᵇ</cite> top <he>כְּבִיסָתָן וחיי אחרים וכ׳</he> as between the use of the spring for their (the inhabitants’) washing purposes and for strangers’ living (drinking purposes); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:1">Mikv. senses.gloss: (also כְּבוּסָה) water mixed with alkaline substances, lye-water &c.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 6:25">Tosef. Shebi. VI, 25</cite> <he>פירות שביעית המשרה ולא לתוך הכ׳ …</he> produces of the Sabbath year must not be used for an infusion nor for preparing lye-water; <cite ref="Sukkah 40a">Succ. 40ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 102a">B. Kam. 102ᵃ</cite>; Y. Shebi. l. c.—Pl. <he>כְּבִיסוֹת</he>. Ib. VII, beg. 37ᵇ <he>מיני כ׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>כניס׳</he>, corr. acc.) alkaline plants.
